supplementaryViews.visualReview: User-reported missing pointer. Reprojected the existing Villa 78 garage anchor for frame 96 and checked Cloudflare preview: paving left of the yellow Beetle. Primary pano 69 retained.

numbering: Player counter is one-based; source frame = panoNumber - 1.

method.numbering: CAD BOUNDRY labels matched against the existing masterplan flattened GLB groups. All 77 included labels agree with their nearest corresponding GLB group after CAD/model translation.
method.modelToPanoCoordinates: GLB X/Z metres correspond to exterior node x/y centimetres divided by 100; model Y is vertical and node z is vertical centimetres.
method.heading: Viewer-local yaw = world bearing atan2(-deltaX, deltaZ), minus the source pano yaw, plus 90 degrees; wrap into [0,360). Source pano yaw is NOT zero on every image.
method.placement: Parking-floor mesh bounds provide the initial anchor. Individual Cloudflare previews were rectilinearly projected for visual review. 18 anchors were adjusted within their parking-floor bounds to avoid vehicles and foreground planting.
method.virtualDistance: 8.5 metres for every marker, inside the panorama sphere. Pitch/yaw follow the real garage direction. The 0.60 m pointer is an interface marker, not a surveyed architectural dimension.
method.interior: All pointers link to the existing shared interior-kitchen-foyer tour. Villa/facing are context parameters, not 77 different interior datasets.
method.exception74: The final flattened GLB group does not export its parking-floor mesh. Its same-template parking floor was located from Villa 77 by the shared entrance-step mesh transform, then visually checked in pano 78.
method.precision: CAD plot identity is checked; placements are visually calibrated against rendered panoramas, not claimed to be survey-grade or pixel-perfect at every zoom.

cadNumberingCheck.note: Text insertion points are not plot centroids; this residual measures label-to-center placement, not arrow calibration accuracy.
